scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:astro
scripts.check: pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:python && pnpm run build
scripts.check:python: uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ruff check tests/support && uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ruff format --check tests/support && uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ty check tests/support
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo check && cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check:web: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:wasm && fnm exec --using=.nvmrc astro dev --open
scripts.format: cargo fmt && oxfmt astro.config.mjs e2e playwright.config.ts package.json src/scripts && pnpm run format:python
scripts.format:python: uv run --project tests/oracles --locked ruff format tests/support
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check astro.config.mjs e2e playwright.config.ts package.json src/scripts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:python && pnpm run test:wasm && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:python: uv run --project tests/oracles --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests/support -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:wasm: cargo test -p qr-render --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --test png_wasm && cargo test -p qr-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib && cargo test -p qr-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --test wasm_browser
scripts.test:approved: cargo test -p qr-render --test approved_combinations --test resource_baselines --test adverse_transforms && pnpm run test:approved:exhaustive
scripts.test:decode: QR_RELEASE_EVIDENCE_DIR=target/release-evidence cargo test -p qr-render --test independent_png_decode --test independent_svg_decode --test logo_decode -- --ignored
scripts.release:fuzz: cargo fuzz run encode_utf8 -- -max_total_time=600 && cargo fuzz run encode_valid_text -- -max_total_time=600 && cargo fuzz run bit_buffer -- -max_total_time=600 && cargo fuzz run reed_solomon -- -max_total_time=600 && cargo fuzz run matrix_build -- -max_total_time=600 && cargo fuzz run render_svg -- -max_total_time=600 && cargo fuzz run render_png -- -max_total_time=600 && cargo fuzz run fixture_parser -- -max_total_time=600
scripts.release:fuzz:deep: cargo fuzz run encode_utf8 -- -max_total_time=3600 && cargo fuzz run reed_solomon -- -max_total_time=3600 && cargo fuzz run matrix_build -- -max_total_time=3600 && cargo fuzz run render_png -- -max_total_time=3600
scripts.release:miri: cargo +nightly miri test -p qr-core && cargo +nightly miri test -p qr-render --lib && cargo +nightly miri test -p qr-render --test profile_geometry --test render_model
scripts.verify:core: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -p qr-core --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p qr-core
scripts.verify:meta: bash scripts/test-select-verification.sh && bash scripts/test-select-pages-deployment.sh && bash scripts/test-workflow-action-pins.sh && bash scripts/test-ci-build-contract.sh && oxlint --deny-warnings scripts/check-doc-links.mjs && oxfmt --check scripts/check-doc-links.mjs package.json && node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs && bash -n scripts/*.sh
scripts.verify:python: pnpm run check:python && pnpm run test:python
scripts.verify:render: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -p qr-render --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p qr-render && cargo test -p qr-render --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --test png_wasm
scripts.verify:web: cargo fmt --check && pnpm run check:web && cargo clippy -p qr-web --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p qr-web && cargo test -p qr-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib --test wasm_browser && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e:dist
